pathway: Suspected hypertension from a single clinic reading
logic_expression: (HTN_CLINIC_SYS_140_TO_LT_180 OR HTN_CLINIC_DIA_90_TO_LT_120) AND NOT (HTN_CLINIC_SYS_GE_180 OR HTN_CLINIC_DIA_GE_120)
card_summary: Suspected hypertension: {{MatchedCriteria}} — confirmatory testing is indicated.
card_detail: A clinic systolic or diastolic blood pressure falls within the suspected-hypertension range. Offer 24-hour ABPM, or HBPM when ABPM is unavailable or not tolerated. A single clinic reading is not diagnostic.
source_label: Guidelines for the Clinical Management of Hypertension in Jamaica, Ministry of Health and Wellness, October 2024
implementation_notes: Uses OR because the source proposal says systolic and/or diastolic; the supplied narrative used 'and', so confirm the intended guideline wording. The AND NOT clause excludes readings where either component is in the severe range (systolic >= 180 or diastolic >= 120), e.g. 150/125 is not suspected hypertension. A reading missing either component evaluates as UNKNOWN, since the severe range cannot be ruled out.

card_summary: Severe blood pressure: {{MatchedCriteria}} — assess for acute target organ damage now.
card_detail: A clinic reading is at or above 180/120 mmHg. Check for signs of acute target organ damage: retinal haemorrhage or papilloedema, new onset confusion, new or evolving neurological signs, chest pain, signs of heart failure, or acute kidney injury. If present, refer for same-day emergency evaluation and start antihypertensive treatment immediately, without waiting for ABPM or HBPM. If absent and this is a first presentation, recheck blood pressure after one hour and start treatment if it remains severely elevated; in a patient with known hypertension, reinstitute or adjust medication. In both cases arrange review within 7 days (24 to 48 hours in some cases).
source_label: Guidelines for the Clinical Management of Hypertension in Jamaica, Ministry of Health and Wellness, October 2024 — Indications for referral to specialist; Management of hypertensive crises
implementation_notes: Not suppressed by an existing hypertension diagnosis: the guideline gives actions for patients with known hypertension too. Evaluates any qualifying clinic reading in the supplied history, so an old severe reading keeps firing; restrict the prefetch to recent observations if that is not wanted. Target organ damage is not assessed from data; the card prompts the clinician to assess it.

pathway: Confirmation by 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure monitoring
card_detail: The 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure average meets the systolic or diastolic diagnostic threshold. Recommend documenting the diagnosis and initiating management according to the national protocol.
source_label: Guidelines for the Clinical Management of Hypertension in Jamaica, Ministry of Health and Wellness, October 2024
implementation_notes: Uses OR for systolic versus diastolic thresholds; all constraints within each criterion apply to the same Observation.

pathway: Confirmation by home blood pressure monitoring
card_detail: The validated home blood pressure monitoring average meets the systolic or diastolic diagnostic threshold. Recommend documenting the diagnosis and initiating management according to the national protocol.
source_label: Guidelines for the Clinical Management of Hypertension in Jamaica, Ministry of Health and Wellness, October 2024
implementation_notes: The first demonstrator assumes the HBPM average has already been calculated according to the national protocol.

pathway: Confirmation by repeat clinic blood pressure
card_detail: ABPM and HBPM are explicitly recorded as unavailable or impractical, and qualifying clinic blood pressure readings are present on at least two separate visits.
source_label: Guidelines for the Clinical Management of Hypertension in Jamaica, Ministry of Health and Wellness, October 2024
implementation_notes: Availability must be explicit CDS Hook context. Missing ABPM or HBPM data alone does not satisfy the rule.
